description: This Java class, TransactionService, handles financial transactions such as fund transfers and utility payments within a banking microservice. It includes methods for validating account balances, performing internal fund transfers, and recording transaction details.

classes.name: TransactionService
classes.description: Service class that manages banking transactions including funds transfer and utility payments, ensuring validation and persistence.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Handles the process of transferring funds between two bank accounts, including validation and transaction record creation.

methods.name: utilPayment
methods.description: Processes utility bill payments, validates balances, and records the transaction.

methods.name: validateBalance
methods.description: Checks if the account has sufficient funds for the transaction, throws exception if not.

methods.name: internalFundTransfer
methods.description: Executes the internal transfer of funds between two accounts, adjusts balances, and records transactions.
